description: This file contains Pydantic models defining schemas for extension configuration and manifest validation in a software project, including classes for extension metadata, frontend/backend configurations, and contribution points.

classes.name: ContributionConfig
classes.description: Configuration for frontend UI contributions, including views, menus, commands, and editors.

classes.name: BaseExtension
classes.description: Base class with shared extension metadata fields.

classes.name: ExtensionConfig
classes.description: Schema for extension.json, combining frontend and backend configurations.

classes.name: Manifest
classes.description: Schema for manifest.json, representing the built extension output.
